messages:
maya: Throwing out an idea: a 'decay-hysteresis' gate for canaries. Instead of immediate rollback on a single breach, require sustained breach over a decay window (e.g. 30m) with exponential weighting. Helps avoid flapping on burst noise.

kevin: sounds useful. How do you define sustained? cumulative score over window?

maya: yes. compute a running breach_score = sum_i w_i * breach_i where w_i = exp(-lambda * age_i). If score exceeds threshold for T minutes we trigger soft-fail or rollback depending on magnitude.

sana: i'd like two tiers: soft-tier (decay score > soft_thresh) -> reduce traffic + extend shadow; hard-tier (decay score > hard_thresh) -> auto-fallback + human-notify. Also include a minimum sample floor so tiny slices don't trip.

kevin: implementation note: rollout-service should emit `decay_score`, `decay_lambda`, `window_minutes`, and `trigger_level` in telemetry. Also keep per-slice decay scores.

infra-bot: quick sim output for run=6722:
```
samples=10k, slices={short:50%, long:30%, misc:20%}
breaches over last 30m: [t0: fidelity=6.1%, t5m: fidelity=4.2%, t12m: p99=160ms, t20m: fidelity=5.5%]
lambda=0.07, computed_decay_score=1.78, soft_thresh=1.2, hard_thresh=2.5 -> soft-tier triggered
actions: reduce traffic to 5%, extend shadow 45m, notify #eng-oncall
```

eval-bot: follow-up after extended shadow (t+50m): decay_score dropped to 0.9, long slice fidelity improved from 5.5% -> 3.3%, aggregate mrr -0.008. No hard-tier.

sana: good. add playbook: if soft-tier persists after two decay windows escalate human triage. Also add cool-down so once a model is rolled back it cannot be auto-promoted for 2h.

kevin: will add flags: `decay_lambda`, `soft_thresh`, `hard_thresh`, `min_samples`, `cooldown_minutes` to model-scoped policy. ETA PR tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Canary started id=6722 -> 10% traffic -> owner=@maya

maya: thanks. we'll monitor and adjust lambda if we see too-slow decay. closing once PR merged and gatebook entry added.
